title:
Comment of Gary Waltenbaugh in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152166.txt
documents.text:
Gary Waltenbaugh, Homer, AK.
The deep waters of Cook Inlet would undergo possibly severe consequences if a submerged DATA CENTER were constructed there.   

In addition, we the residents of the Kenai Peninsula, adjacent  to the Cook Inlet, are already facing a future with not enough reasonably-priced Electricy for our current business and residential needs!   And the demand / load from this Data Center will exacerbate the problem for us, and likely raise our electricity cost EVEN MORE!    

The Cook Inlet is a veritable “lifeline” for us here; for transportation, fishing, tourism, local businesses, etc:   PLEASE don’t jeopardize this valuable, one-of-a-kind, natural resource for a data center that is neither needed, or wanted.  

Thank you for considering these comments,

                    Gary S. Waltenbaugh
                   Resident, South Kenai Peninsula
